title: Finite Free Root-Gap Dynamics: Universal Marcel Riesz Monotonicity, Sharp Degree-3-to-4 Euclidean and Hyperbolic Pythagorean Transitions, and Exact Heat-Flow Compression
abstract: We investigate the evolution of the minimum root spacing gap(p) = min_{1 <= i < d}(lambda_{i+1}(p) - lambda_i(p)) and minimum root ratio rat(p) = min_{1 <= i < d}(lambda_{i+1}(p)/lambda_i(p)) of real-rooted degree-d polynomials under the finite free additive convolution boxplus_d and multiplicative convolution boxtimes_d of Marcus, Spielman, and Srivastava. While the finite free entropy power inequality governs the geometric mean of all pairwise gaps superadditively in every degree, we prove that the minimum gap undergoes a sharp phase transition at d = 3 -> 4 in both Euclidean (additive) and hyperbolic (multiplicative) geometries: (1) Universal Finite Free Marcel Riesz Monotonicity: gap(p boxplus_d q) >= max(gap(p), gap(q)) on P_d^R and rat(p boxtimes_d q) >= max(rat(p), rat(q)) on P_d^{R>0} for all d >= 2 via Obreschkoff interlacing and Walsh/Szego composition, giving a universal 1/2-Pythagorean floor; (2) Exact Degree-2,3 Laws: exact additive Pythagorean superadditivity gap(p boxplus_3 q)^2 >= gap(p)^2 + gap(q)^2 (with full equality characterization), exact degree-2 hyperbolic Pythagorean identity cosh(0.5 log rat(p boxtimes_2 q)) = cosh(0.5 log rat p) cosh(0.5 log rat q), and a strictly stronger cubic supermultiplicative law mu(p boxtimes_3 q)/3 >= (mu(p)/3)(mu(q)/3) for mu(p) = rat(p) + 1 + rat(p)^{-1} proved via a deformed cubic discriminant factorization and a star-shaped semigroup potential Phi(alpha, beta) on (0,1)^2; (3) Exact Finite Free Heat-Flow Expansion: for p_T = p boxplus_d He_d^{(T)}, deterministic Dyson dynamics yield the globally optimal inequality gap(p_T)^2 >= gap(p)^2 + kappa_d gap(He_d^{(T)})^2 for all d >= 2 and T >= 0 with sharp constant kappa_d = c_d^heat / gap(He_d)^2 (kappa_2 = kappa_3 = 1, kappa_4 = (3+sqrt(6))/6, kappa_5 = (5+sqrt(10))/9, kappa_d -> 8/pi^2), and Sturm-Liouville comparison certifies kappa_d < 1 for every d >= 4, proving universal d >= 4 failure in both boxplus_d and (via an infinitesimal limit lemma) boxtimes_d, supplemented by closed-form self-convolution counterexamples 5 - 7/sqrt(3) (d=4) and (10 - sqrt(38))/4 (d=5); and (4) Voiculescu R-Transform Asymptotics: for the k-fold free additive convolution U^{boxplus k} of Unif[-1/2, 1/2], global analytic continuation and the holomorphic inverse function theorem prove real-analyticity near 0 with exact central density rho_k(0) = 2 u_k / pi (u_k cot u_k = (k-1)/k) and inverse-density-squared ratio R_k = pi^2 / (4 k u_k^2) descending strictly from pi^2/(8 u_2^2) ~ 0.9081 to the free-CLT Basel constant pi^2/12 ~ 0.8225, matching numerical high-degree self-convolution gap scaling. The exact algebraic core (16 theorems) is formalized in Lean 4.36.0 (zero sorry, zero grind, zero custom axioms).
